import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variant typo (Adeile -> Adelie)
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (numbers stored as text)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Drop out-of-range body mass values (4850000 is invalid; allowed 2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = {}
    grouped = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    for species, value in grouped.items():
        if pd.notna(species) and pd.notna(value):
            result[str(species)] = float(value)
    return result
